Learned counsel for the petition er filed a memo which reads as under:
"In this the Ad vocate for petitioner sub mits as under:
That the petitioner had filed the above criminal p etition before this Hon'ble Court seeking quashing of FIR registered in Hanumasagar P.S. Crime No.70/2021 for the alleged offences punishable under section 323, 307, 420, 504, 506 R/w. Section 34 of IPC.

After filing of charge sheet in the above crime no. 27/03/2023 the petitioner has filed another Cri minal Petition bearing No. 100885/2023 before this Hon'ble Court under section 482 of Cr.P.C. seeking quashing of charge s heet and entire criminal proceedings in C.C. No. 415/2022 on the file of Addl. Civil Judge and JMFC Court,
Kustagi.

As it was under impression that the petitioner has already withdrawn the criminal petition No. 100147/2022, but it is come to know when the matter listed in today's cause list before this Hon'ble Court as that the above matter is not yet withdrawn.
And also after filing of charge sheet th e petition does not s urvive for con sideration .
Hence, the petitioner intend s to withdraw the Criminal Petition No.100147/ 2022.

Therefore, this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to dismi ss the Crl. Petition No.100147/
2022 as withdrawn, in the end of justice."
